summary: dawn awakens. Our sun glistens time frozen in fading frost For trees, leaves long fallen, speak today of poetry A cadence carried on weight of shrinking shadows in the prosody of our politic. #smallpoems #clmooc
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
dawn
awakens.

Our sun
glistens
time frozen
in fading
frost
For trees,
leaves long
fallen,
speak today
of poetry
A cadence
carried
on weight
of shrinking
shadows
in the prosody
of our politic.
